dismissals.because: apps/core/src/runtime/group-processing.ts:763 plans/TURN-1.md line 91 and owner decision 2026-09-29: the final retry keeps its input consumed; the progress card shows the failed state

findings.body: A question followed by an authorized `/commands` is answered through the pre-command runner (`session-commands.ts:335-340`). If sending the help list then fails (`session-commands.ts:367-369`), this catch releases both admission items because its separate `outputSentToUser` flag was never set by the pre-command answer. The next turn can answer the question again. Track delivered pre-command output before deciding whether to release input, and cover this failure path in a test.
findings.title: Not done: No message is lost or given twice

findings.body: `routeScopeActiveLiveTurnAdmission` appends the durable continuation before awaiting `onRouted` (`live-recovery-coordinator.ts:333-343`). That callback still saves the old marker (`live-turn-continuation.ts:39-43`). If saving fails, this catch releases the admission item while the continuation remains queued for the owner. The owner can receive it, and a later turn can take the released item again. Keep the item consumed once the command is durably queued, regardless of marker-write failure.
findings.title: Do not release a follow-up after queuing its continuation

findings.body: Ordinary turns pass `admissionAppId`, but the pre-command and compaction runs assembled in the unchanged `group-session-command-runner.ts:39-53` omit it. The changed runner falls back to the JID or `default` here. For a non-default app using a normal channel JID, a session-command run therefore resolves provider configuration and agent session context in the wrong app.
findings.title: Pass the admission app ID to session-command agent runs
